description:
FALCONS from Cairo, Egypt, is tackling the Martian Map challenge: a layered, interactive map of a Mars route combining NASA data (terrain, slope, hazards) to help astronauts plan a safe Marswalk.

I'm Amr Nabil, a Data Engineer, leading the data pipeline.

We need: frontend/web developers, a UI designer, someone into GIS or planetary science, and a video/writing person.

No expertise required, just curiosity and teamwork. Join us!
